answers.answer: CONDITIONAL INVEST is the analytical posture and is explicitly not approved. Workflow is HOLD; human authority is PENDING HUMAN with no investment approval; and the record is PENDING FOUNDER SIGNATURE with seven required conditions.

The proposed structure is a $25M initial Series C close and a $15M conditional tranche only after milestone tests and human approval, targeting 20.0% fully diluted ownership. No valuation or per-share price is shown.

Retention and margin support milestone-gated funding, not immediate full funding. Ordinary-cohort NRR is 117.07%, blended gross margin is 70.61%, and 48 inflated opportunities flag pipeline quality. The funded case yields 60.3% gross XIRR and 9.19x gross MOIC.
Down-round dilution and weaker exit economics reduce returns to 9.6% gross XIRR and 1.58x gross MOIC, below the 30% and 3.0x hurdles. Separate seeded paths show 0.10% probability below 1.0x.

Withhold the $15M tranche until pipeline history and provider unit costs reconcile, and do not fund the $25M first close until ownership and every waterfall scenario reconcile to executed terms. If unresolved, HOLD remains and the no-contingent-financing path exhausts cash in month 36.
